parameters.content:
## Demo lead generator (local testing only)
Posts a mixed batch through the **real** intake webhooks:
- Meta leads in the real webhook format, signed with META_APP_SECRET (details come from the Graph API)
- website leads in English and Arabic
- the last one is a family inquiring again, which should be merged with no second alert

**Easiest:** open http://localhost:5678/webhook/leadops/demo-leads?count=5 in the browser. After about 10 s it shows what happened to each lead, with links to every step. These runs appear in the **Executions** tab, not on this canvas.

**From the editor:** pick "Run it (button)" in the Execute button's menu, then click a node to see its data.

parameters.query:
SELECT b.source, b.status AS inbox_status, left(b.last_error, 200) AS error,
       i.id AS inquiry_id, i.status, i.duplicate_of, i.public_token, i.language, i.campaign_name,
       l.full_name, l.phone_e164, l.crm_record_id, i.notified_at IS NOT NULL AS notified,
       coalesce(a.name, oa.name) AS agent_name, coalesce(a.code, oa.code) AS agent_code
  FROM leadops.inbox b
  LEFT JOIN leadops.inquiries i ON i.id = b.inquiry_id
  LEFT JOIN leadops.leads l ON l.id = i.lead_id
  LEFT JOIN leadops.agents a ON a.id = i.assigned_agent_id
  LEFT JOIN leadops.inquiries o ON o.id = i.duplicate_of
  LEFT JOIN leadops.agents oa ON oa.id = o.assigned_agent_id
 WHERE b.event_key IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb))
 ORDER BY b.id;
